correctness.rationale: Every factorial moment term is either zero for overlapping incompatible codewords or a product of single-window probabilities for disjoint independent letter blocks; hence the whole pgf is the weighted independence polynomial of a claw-free path power. The established claw-free real-rootedness theorem extends to nonnegative weights by exact rational clique substitution and limits. Nonnegative normalized polynomial coefficients and real zeros force Bernoulli factorization. For the bordered case the shortest period yields exactly one simultaneous pair at sample size L+s, a quadratic pgf with discriminant pi²[(s+1)²−4/h]; positivity and the quadratic real-root criterion prove the claimed sharp boundary. Direct enumeration and stationary coefficient identities were independently tested in rational arithmetic; finite tests do not prove infinite claims.

value.rationale: This is a structurally natural complete classification of when local motif-count dependence can nevertheless be represented as a sum of independent Bernoulli trials, uniform over every sample size and source law. It extends naturally to cross-bifix-free families with nonidentical observations, and it isolates a sharp parameter boundary at first self-overlap, explaining how universality fails. The result supplies an exact finite-sample stationary pgf, not merely a renamed routine computation.
